item.title: Campfire citrus pancakes
item.description:
1. Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a bowl.

  2. In a second bowl, whisk the milk, egg, orange zest, and melted butter. Stir into the dry ingredients just until combined; a few small lumps are fine.

  3. Warm a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat. Cook small ladlefuls of batter until bubbles appear on top, then flip and cook until golden.

  4. Serve warm with maple syrup and berries.

item.title: Slow-roasted tomato pasta
item.description:
1. Heat the oven to 170°C / 340°F. Put the tomatoes and garlic in a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and chilli flakes.

  2. Roast for 40 to 45 minutes, until the tomatoes have collapsed and their juices are syrupy.

Tipp

If your tomatoes are on the large side, halve them before roasting so they soften evenly.

  1. Cook the pasta in well-salted water until just al dente. Save a mug of pasta water before draining.

  2. Fold the pasta into the tomatoes with the Parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy, then finish with basil and more Parmesan.

item.title: Lemon and herb roast chicken
item.description:
1. Heat the oven to 200°C / 400°F. Pat the chicken dry and season it generously inside and out.

  2. Put half the herbs, the lemon halves, and garlic inside the cavity. Rub the skin with olive oil and scatter the remaining herbs over the chicken and potatoes.

  3. Arrange the potatoes in a roasting pan and sit the chicken on top. Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the potatoes once, until the chicken is deeply golden and cooked through.
